title: 第1965章 万药阁第1964章 酒摊闲话
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
恰在此时，江尘把剥好的一叠果仁送到虞紫鸢面前，她微微发愣，恍然间，她似乎觉得眼前的世界似与以前看到的不同，
以前她站在仙宫俯视人间，那些渺小的生命在她眼中如同蝼蚁，朝生暮死，不值一提。
可现在，当她坐在这个破旧的酒摊上，喝着浑浊的粗酒，听着一个天君境老者絮叨他的人生，身边坐着一个会给她剥果仁的人...
她忽然发现，那些人不是蝼蚁。
他们有喜怒哀乐，有爱恨情仇，有值得守护的东西，有值得怀念的人。
他们的人生虽然短暂，却并不苍白，
比如这个老者，他等了三百年，明知道儿子可能已经陨落在外，却依旧守在这里，守着这个酒摊，难道不也是一种道吗？
一种不同于追求长生、追求力量的道。
“老人家。”
虞紫鸢忽然开口，
“您儿子...可有留下什么东西？”
老者怔了怔，随即从怀中摸出一块玉简，小心翼翼地放在桌上，玉简很普通，是最低等的那种，里面的内容也很简单，只有一句话，
“爹，孩儿不孝，待孩儿证得大道，定回来接您。”
三百年过去，这句话一直没有兑现，或许再无兑现的可能，
说到这里，老者站起身来，又给两人各斟了一碗酒：
“不说这些了，两位是来参加元天道宴的天骄吧？来来来，老汉敬你们一碗，祝你们在道宴上大放异彩。”
江尘端起酒碗，与老者碰了一下：
“借老人家吉言。”
虞紫鸢也端起碗，这一次她没有犹豫，一饮而尽。
临别时，江尘从怀中取出几枚玄晶放在桌上，对老者这样的修士来说，已经是一笔不小的财富。

老者连忙摆手：
“使不得使不得，几碗酒值不了这么多...”
而后强行推回江尘手中，只收下两枚上品灵石，
江尘并没强求，站起身来，与虞紫鸢一同离去。
走出老远，虞紫鸢回头看了一眼，灯火阑珊处，那个老者依旧坐在酒摊前，身影显得有些孤单，却又透着一种说不清的坚韧。
然后她看到江尘手指微动，一道流光悄无声息地没入虚空，落在了老者的酒坛上面，那是几枚玄晶，江尘最终留了下来。
虞紫鸢的眸光微微闪烁，并未说破。
。。。
两人很快穿过这片破旧的长街，重新回到主街时，天色已经彻底黑了下来。
玄煌城的夜并不安静，到处都是灵灯、夜光珠之类的照明法器，将整座城池映照得如同白昼。来往的修士比白天更多，其中不乏气息强大的存在。
界皇随处可见，帝尊也不在少数，
前方就是虞紫鸢要找的坊市，每一间店铺都金碧辉煌，门前的匾额上刻着各种大族的徽记。
灵药铺、法器铺、丹药铺、符箓铺，应有尽有，那些陈列在柜台中的货物，随便一件放在外面，都足以引起一场腥风血雨。
虞紫鸢在一间灵药铺前停下了脚步。
这间铺子门面极大，门口的匾额上刻着万药阁三字，旁边还有一个小巧的徽记——其上印着九玄二字。
铺子里的伙计一看到虞紫鸢的气度，立刻满脸堆笑地迎了上来。
“姑娘请进，我们万药阁的灵药品种齐全，品质上乘，保管让您满意。”
content_en:
At this moment, Jiang Chen brought a pile of peeled nuts to Yu Ziyuan. She was slightly dazed. Suddenly, she seemed to feel that the world in front of her was different from what she had seen before.
In the past, she stood in the Immortal Palace and looked down at the human world. In her eyes, those tiny lives were like ants, living and dying, not worth mentioning.
But now, when she was sitting in this dilapidated wine stall, drinking turbid wine, listening to an old man from the Tianjun realm talking about his life, sitting next to her was a man who would peel nuts for her...
She suddenly realized that those people were not ants.
They have joys and sorrows, love and hatred, things worth protecting, and people worth remembering.
Although their lives are short, they are not pale.
For example, this old man has waited for three hundred years, knowing that his son may have died, but he still stays here and guards this wine stall. Isn't it a kind of Tao?
A Tao that is different from pursuing immortality and pursuing strength.
"Old man."
Yu Ziyuan suddenly spoke,
"Your son...did you leave anything behind?"
The old man was startled, and then he took out a jade slip from his arms and placed it carefully on the table. The jade slip was very ordinary, the lowest kind, and the content inside was also very simple, with only one sentence,
"Dad, the child is unfilial. When the child attains the great truth, he will come back to pick you up."
Three hundred years have passed, and this sentence has not been fulfilled, and perhaps there is no possibility of it ever being fulfilled again.
Having said this, the old man stood up and poured another bowl of wine for each of them:
"Stop talking about this, are you two geniuses who are here to attend the Yuantian Tao Banquet? Come on, come on, I will give you a bowl and wish you a great success at the Tao Banquet."
Jiang Chen picked up the wine bowl and touched it with the old man:
"I'd like to lend you some good advice from the old man."
Yu Ziyuan also picked up the bowl, and this time she drank it all without hesitation.
When leaving, Jiang Chen took out a few mysterious crystals from his arms and placed them on the table. For a monk like the old man, they were already a considerable amount of wealth.
The old man waved his hand quickly:
"You can't do it, you can't do it, a few bowls of wine aren't worth so much..."
Then he pushed it back to Jiang Chen's hands and only accepted two high-grade spiritual stones.
Jiang Chen didn't force it, he stood up and left with Yu Ziyuan.
After walking far away, Yu Ziyuan looked back. In the dim light, the old man was still sitting in front of the wine stall. His figure looked a little lonely, but showed an indescribable tenacity.
Then she saw Jiang Chen's fingers move slightly, and a stream of light quietly disappeared into the void and landed on the old man's wine jar. They were several mysterious crystals, and Jiang Chen finally kept them.
Yu Ziyuan's eyes flickered slightly, but she didn't say anything.
. . .
The two quickly crossed the dilapidated long street and when they returned to the main street, it was completely dark.
The night in Xuanhuang City is not quiet. There are lighting instruments such as spiritual lamps and luminous beads everywhere, making the entire city look like daylight. There were more monks coming and going than during the day, and many of them had powerful auras.
Realm Emperors can be seen everywhere, and there are also many Emperors.
Ahead is the market that Yu Ziyuan is looking for. Every shop is splendid, with the emblems of various wealthy families engraved on the plaques in front of the doors.
There are elixir shops, magic weapon shops, elixir shops, and talisman shops. If any of the goods displayed on the counter are placed outside, it is enough to cause a bloody storm.
Yu Ziyuan stopped in front of a spiritual medicine shop.
This shop has a huge facade. On the plaque at the door is engraved the word Wanyao Pavilion, and next to it is a small emblem - the word Jiuxuan is printed on it.
As soon as the waiters in the shop saw Yu Ziyuan's demeanor, they immediately came over with smiles on their faces.
"Girl, please come in. Our Wanyao Pavilion has a complete range of elixirs of high quality. We will keep them to your satisfaction."
